tools.name: refresh_karaoke_quote
tools.description: Refresh an expired, unstarted project's quote and status. Show the returned terms before starting. Does not reserve funds or launch processing.

tools.name: list_karaokes
tools.description: List the connected account's Quick projects to find work to continue in this chat.

tools.name: retry_karaoke
tools.description: Retry a failed or stale Quick stage only when can_retry is true. Keeps the existing project, saved visual preferences and completed stages. This does not request a new creative design.

tools.name: cancel_karaoke
tools.description: Cancel this Quick workflow when can_cancel is true. Stops successor stages; completed preparation charges follow the existing service rules.

tools.name: open_in_studio
tools.description: Hand this project from automatic Quick processing to the full Studio editor when the user requests manual correction. Stops Quick automation; this is an intentional change, not just a preview link.

tools.name: get_karaoke_lyrics
tools.description: Read a bounded range of this project's saved lyric lines and their revision, without changing processing. Use for a user-requested lyric check or correction; do not invent missing text or silently rewrite repeats. Respect content rights when discussing lyrics in chat. No review card is opened.

tools.name: replace_karaoke_lyrics

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_local_upload, start_karaoke, get_karaoke, list_karaokes, get_karaoke_lyrics, get_youtube_import · Private data: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload, update_karaoke_visuals · Public sink: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload, get_karaoke, show_karaoke.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_local_upload, start_karaoke, get_karaoke, list_karaokes, get_karaoke_lyrics, get_youtube_import · Private data: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload, update_karaoke_visuals · Public sink: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload, get_karaoke, show_karaoke

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
